summary: Frontend-only bug regression for 'home shows only favorite categories'. All 7 requested scenarios PASSED end-to-end against https://populus-gossip.preview.emergentagent.com. Registered user chat_a@test.it with favorite_categories=['tech','cronaca'] sees chip row [TUTTE, TECH, CRONACA] (7 non-favorite chips hidden) and 'Tutte' feed contains only TECH+CRONACA cards. Selecting TECH chip shows only TECH cards; selecting CRONACA shows only CRONACA cards. Updating favorites via PATCH /api/auth/me/profile to ['musica'] and reloading updates the chip row to [TUTTE, MUSICA] and the feed to MUSICA-only cards. Anonymous user (favorites=[]) sees all 10 chips (Tutte + 9 categories) and the Tutte feed contains cards from all 9 categories, confirming the fallback branch. No React Native deprecated packages, no red-screen errors, no console errors related to this feature.
action_items: No action required — home category filtering by user.favorite_categories works exactly as specified for both registered and anonymous users.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx L58-66: filtering the 'all' scope by user.favorite_categories is done client-side after the /feuds fetch — fine for the current volume (~26 feuds) but consider server-side filtering (POST body or repeated category params) if the corpus grows past a few hundred, otherwise mobile clients will download and drop feuds they will never see.

index.tsx L92: setSelected('all') is unconditionally called inside the categories/favorites effect. If the user was already viewing e.g. 'chip-tech' and their favorites change under them (e.g. remote profile edit), the tab silently jumps back to Tutte. Acceptable but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used chat_a@test.it (pre-verified) and toggled its favorite_categories via PATCH /api/auth/me/profile. Favorites left at ['tech','cronaca'] at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To authenticate as a registered user in the web preview (email/password tab is HIDDEN), login via POST /api/auth/login then inject the token before app JS runs using page.add_init_script with `localStorage.setItem('faide_token', JSON.stringify('<jwt>'))`. AsyncStorage on web is backed by localStorage under the exact key `faide_token` and the value is JSON-encoded (i.e. quoted). Chip row items expose data-testid=chip-<id> (chip-all, chip-tech, chip-cronaca, chip-politica, chip-tv, chip-musica, chip-sport, chip-cinema, chip-social, chip-gossip). To assert feud card categories while excluding the chip row, exclude descendants of [data-testid='category-chip-row'].
rca_of_issue: Original bug: home always showed every category chip and every feud. Root cause was that HomeFeed built the chip list directly from GET /api/categories and rendered the raw /api/feuds response without any client-side favorites filter. Fix (already applied in index.tsx L68-97 and L50-66): the chip row is now [Tutte, ...user.favorite_categories] with a fallback to all categories when favorites are empty, and when the 'Tutte' scope is active the feed is filtered by `favSet.has(f.category)`. Both branches are keyed on `user.favorite_categories` in useEffect deps so profile edits + refreshMe re-render correctly. Verified by A/B comparison between registered chat_a (favs=[tech,cronaca] → 3 chips, 2 label types) and a fresh anonymous session (0 favs → 10 chips, 9 label types).
